page_title: REI 0-0 NIC | Reims v Nice 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The Reims players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90+2' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Here comes a substitution. Aliou Balde (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Terem Moffi.
87' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:5.
83' Joseph Okumu is being substituted because of an injury. Will Still sends Thomas Foket (Reims) on the pitch.
83' Joseph Okumu (Reims) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
80' Keito Nakamura (Reims) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
78' Francesco Farioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) replacing Hicham Boudaoui.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gaetan Laborde (Nice) will replace Jeremie Boga.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
75' 4:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
72' Junya Ito (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.
72' Will Still has decided to substitute Amir Richardson and he is replaced by Amadou Kone (Reims).

69' Oumar Diakite (Reims) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thibault De Smet (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Sergio Akieme cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keito Nakamura replaces Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed-Ali Cho departs the field of play to be replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
60' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
59' Reims hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Nice is cautioned for aggressive play.
53' The ball possession is 49:51.
50' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) for his blatant foul.
49' Yehvann Diouf displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' Reims are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jeremie Boga (Nice) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
41' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Jeremie Boga (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
39' Joseph Okumu (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
37' 0:2 – the corner kicks stats.
35' Amir Richardson (Reims) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Reims are seeing far more of the ball now.
31' Melvin Bard (Nice) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
29' The total number of attempts is 2:7.
26' Jeremie Boga (Nice) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
25' Khephren Thuram (Nice) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
23' The ball is cleared after Melvin Bard (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Ambitious effort from Marshall Munetsi (Reims). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
17' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Some patient build-up play from Nice as they look to unlock the defence.
13' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
12' Sergio Akieme (Reims) is punished with the yellow card.
11' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 55:45.
9' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
7' Close! Terem Moffi (Nice) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
3' Some neat passing and movement from Reims as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Reims will kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
